review.assessment: The change modifies `jobs/sla.py` to treat all terminal statuses (including the newly added `cancelled`) correctly when calculating job duration. Previously, only `DONE` and `FAILED` stopped the clock; now any status considered 'terminal' by `st.is_terminal()` will stop the clock at its `ended_at` time. This directly addresses the operations report where cancelled jobs were incorrectly accumulating duration (using `now` instead of `ended_at`) in SLA calculations.
